verification_method: GitHub REST API v3 (issue/PR JSON, comments, timeline, search) fetched via web_fetch; one issue HTML page fetched as connectivity check. fetched_at values are the batch clock times recorded around each batch of fetches (Get-Date), accurate to about +/-30 s; they are not per-URL stopwatch measurements.

evidence_levels.ER: external report: upstream issue/PR gives verifiable version, path and failure signature; not locally reproduced by this package
evidence_levels.SH: source-derived hypothesis: fixed-source reading, needs an executable test to upgrade
evidence_levels.FI: fault injection: controlled completion/loss/reorder; proves oracle sensitivity, not a natural defect
evidence_levels.LR: locally reproduced on real components at a pinned version, with original logs and a minimal trace

clusters.name: stale completion after abort+free (LMCache MP connector <-> vLLM Scheduler)
clusters.clause: completion must not follow free; send for a request at most once; finished_sending must be a subset of current or historical finished_req_ids
clusters.minimal_trigger: submit retrieve -> abort lands before the scheduler consumes finished_recving -> recv report frees and deletes the request -> next step the worker reports finished_sending for the same id -> assert req_id in self.requests
clusters.root_cause_note: The scheduler frees on the first completion report and has one boolean (not per-direction obligations) for outstanding transfers; the connector can still report the other direction in a later step. Members are two connector-side fixes plus four scheduler-side fix attempts / trigger variants.

local_repro.summary: GPU E2E assertion hit on two version pairs (vLLM 0.25.1+LMCache 0.5.1; vLLM 0.31.0+LMCache dev@90a4ae2f); recorded 0.25.1 trace reproduces I_COMPLETION_AFTER_FREE via kvc check; component search 200 fresh cells per target; fixed tree 4/4 negative on the same workload.
local_repro.boundary: Single-workload control, controlled I/O for component cells, one trial per trigger config; not a production incidence estimate. scheduler_fix_boundary is a local patch that mimics PR #55286 semantics, not merged upstream code.

clusters.name: second-direction / duplicate completion in one step (NIXL pull, HMA multi-group)
clusters.clause: each (request, direction) completion is reported at most once; the first completion must not free blocks while the other direction is still owed
clusters.minimal_trigger: abort while both recv and send are outstanding -> both completions are reported in the same step/output -> recv branch frees the request -> send branch trips assert req_id in self.requests (multi-KV-group models also hit a trailing duplicate finished_recving)
clusters.root_cause_note: Same scheduler ownership defect as K1 but a different necessary condition (same-step dual report or duplicate recv). Kept as a separate cluster because the minimal reproduction and harness differ.

local_repro.summary: Real NIXL pull connector methods plus the real vLLM Scheduler were driven with a same-batch recv+send completion and produced a real AssertionError (I_ABORTED_DUAL_COMPLETION); dual_completion monitor hits 65/200 with 73 real assertions in the controlled-I/O sweep.
local_repro.boundary: NIXL transport state and send notification are controlled/fake; no GPU E2E for the dual-completion family.

clusters.name: in-flight transfer never completes (PROC) -> blocks held forever
clusters.clause: every aborted recv reaches a terminal state within a deadline; resources are not held indefinitely and invisibly
clusters.minimal_trigger: NIXL READ stays in PROC -> client aborts -> pull scheduler stops the heartbeat and returns -> get_finished never reports completion -> blocks are not released until the process restarts
clusters.root_cause_note: No pull-side consumer deadline (push side has a deadline that only logs); the abort never reaches the worker's receive side.

clusters.name: release before quiescence: the assert fires after the hazardous event
clusters.clause: destination blocks must not be reused before DMA/transfer is proven stopped; a log-and-continue guard must not mask the lifetime race
clusters.minimal_trigger: send completion reported first -> blocks freed and reallocated -> recv DMA still lands in the old blocks -> only the later recv report trips the assert
clusters.root_cause_note: Scheduler records outstanding transfers as one boolean and releases on the first report, so release can precede quiescence. Cross-connector RFC: same assertion reported for LMCache, Nixl, Mooncake and MultiConnector.

local_repro.summary: No RDMA and no GPU physical-reclamation measurement in this workspace.
local_repro.boundary: accounting.json is scheduler KVCacheManager.free accounting (391 frees / 0 duplicate ids), not proof of physical block reclamation; it cannot demonstrate DMA overlap.

clusters.name: MultiConnector child-ownership / fan-out aggregation
clusters.clause: aggregate completions by (child, request, attempt) identity; a completion count must not substitute for identity; each child completion at most once
clusters.minimal_trigger: MultiConnector picks one child to load KV but still passes the original request (with kv_transfer_params) to the other children -> non-chosen children start async KV transfers -> get_finished reports them as done receiving while scheduler state no longer matches -> assert RequestStatus.is_finished(req.status)
clusters.root_cause_note: Child ownership/state is not scoped per child; the C10 count-based premature-global-completion counterexample is a related but distinct SH/FI family with no upstream report, so it is not presented as an ER member.

local_repro.summary: Real vLLM 0.25.1 MultiConnector forwards all child completions; k=c*a bare-id counting law holds (3/7/7/15 bare alerts, scoped 0); controlled child schedules.
local_repro.boundary: Controlled child schedule; no claim that duplicate child completions occur naturally in a GPU MultiConnector deployment.

clusters.name: cancel vs terminal finish conflation (SGLang cache-request lifecycle)
clusters.clause: every cache request attempt receives exactly one terminal finish(handle, outcome), after any required KV release or STORE; cancel must not substitute for finalization and no session/read-lock may outlive the attempt
clusters.minimal_trigger: match_prefix opens an MP session on host hit -> request aborted before init_load_back -> default release_aborted_request is a no-op -> load-back markers, pending lookup, daemon read locks and the live session leak; the naive fix produces end_session -> store_kv -> end_session
clusters.root_cause_note: BasePrefixCache.finish(ABORT) is implemented as release_aborted_request, so cancellation and terminal finalization are made equivalent by the base implementation; backends require opposite orderings (FlexKV cancel-before-STORE, LMCache close-after-STORE).

local_repro.summary: Only an adapter-level probe was run (lookup_kv/release_pending/retrieve_kv/end_session); no SGLang engine runtime.
local_repro.boundary: The probe cannot reach SGLang's release hook or init_load_back call sites; do not claim local SGLang coverage.

clusters.name: scheduler-role connector dereferences worker-only engine
clusters.clause: a role-legal abort must not crash; scheduler-role code must not require worker-only state
clusters.minimal_trigger: scheduler-role request_finished(FINISHED_ABORTED) -> assert self.lmcache_engine is not None (the scheduler role has no engine by design) -> any client disconnect kills EngineCore
clusters.root_cause_note: Connector is instantiated per role; the engine and lookup client are created on the worker role, but request_finished is a scheduler-side hook.
